SysDataModelXML.SQLClear: --LINKREFRESH INSERT INTO XWSMKI ( MACHINEID_0 ,USERID_0 ,CUSERID_0 ,VCRTYP_0 ,PK_0 ,BATCHID_0 ,PKORI_0 ,CREDATIM_0 ,STAT_0 ,SUBDATIM_0 ,RPFLG_0 ,RPNUM_0 ,RPLIN_0 ,RPNOTE_0 ,RPDATE_0 ,RPDATIM_0 ,MFGFCY_0 ,MFGNUM_0 ,ITMREF_0 ,UOMCPLQTY_0 ,UOM_0 ,UOMSTUCOE_0 ,MFGTRKNUM_0 ,PCU_0 ,QTYPCU_0 ,PCUSTUCOE_0 ,LOC_0 ,STA_0 ,LOT_0 ,SLO_0 ,PALNUM_0 ,CTRNUM_0 ,SHLDAT_0 ,XCREUSR_0 ,VCRLIN_0 ,YUOMCPLQTY_0 ,UOMCPLQTY2_0 ,YUOMCPLQTY2_0 ,UOM2_0 ,BPSLOT_0 ,CREDATTIM_0,UPDDATTIM_0,AUUID_0,CREUSR_0,UPDUSR_0,WRH_0,XTXT_0,XTXT_1,XTXT_2, XDCB_0,XDCB_1,XDCB_2, XDAT_0,XDAT_1,XDAT_2 ,SERNUM_0 ,XRMK1_0,XRMK2_0 ,XRMK3_0,XRMK4_0) SELECT '#LOGIN_ID#' AS MACHINEID_0 ,'' AS USERID_0 ,'#LOGIN_USER#' AS CUSERID_0 ,15 AS VCRTYP_0 ,'#LINKID_ACTION#' AS PK_0 ,'#LINKID_ACTION#' AS BATCHID_0 ,' ' AS PKORI_0 ,GETDATE() AS CREDATIM_0 ,1 AS STAT_0 ,'' AS SUBDATIM_0 ,1 AS RPFLG_0 ,' ' AS RPNUM_0 ,0 AS RPLIN_0 ,' ' AS RPNOTE_0 ,'1900-01-01' AS RPDATE_0 ,'1900-01-01' AS RPDATIM_0 ,O.MFGFCY_0 AS MFGFCY_0 ,O.MFGNUM_0 AS MFGNUM_0 ,O.ITMREF_0 AS ITMREF_0 ,1 UOMCPLQTY_0 ,ITM.STU_0 AS UOM_0 ,1 AS UOMSTUCOE_0 ,' ' AS MFGTRKNUM_0 ,ITM.STU_0 AS PCU_0 ,1 QTYPCU_0 ,1 AS PCUSTUCOE_0 ,'#默认库位#' AS LOC_0 ,'A' AS STA_0 ,'' AS LOT_0 ,' ' AS SLO_0 ,'' AS PALNUM_0 --#生产计划号# ,'' AS CTRNUM_0 ,GETDATE() SHLDAT_0 ,'' ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,GETDATE(),GETDATE(),NEWID(),LEFT('#LOGIN_USER#',5),' ', ISNULL((SELECT WRH_0 FROM STOLOC WHERE LOC_0='{6}'AND O.MFGFCY_0=STOFCY_0),''), '{8}' XTXT_0, '{9}' XTXT_1, '' XTXT_2, (SELECT COUNT(SERNUM_0)+1 FROM XWSMKI WHERE MFGNUM_0='#工单编号#') XDCB_0, 0, 0, '1900-01-01', '1900-01-01', '1900-01-01', '{7}', '', '', '', '' FROM MFGITM O INNER JOIN MFGHEAD H ON H.MFGNUM_0 = O.MFGNUM_0 LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0=O.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON ITF.ITMREF_0=O.ITMREF_0 AND ITF.STOFCY_0=O.MFGFCY_0 WHERE O.MFGNUM_0 = '#工单编号#' AND O.ITMREF_0 = '#产品编码#' AND '{7}' NOT IN (SELECT SERNUM_0 FROM XWSMKI WHERE SERNUM_0='{7}' AND ITMREF_0='#产品编码#') AND '{7}'<>''
